description: Holds the query cache and defaults. Installed once with `app.use(VueQueryPlugin, { queryClient })`.
Array identifying cached data. May contain refs or getters; changes trigger a new fetch.
How long data is fresh (no refetch) and how long unused cache entries survive.
Runs writes with `mutate()` and exposes `isPending`, `isError`, `data` and lifecycle callbacks.
Marks matching queries stale and refetches active ones, typically after a mutation.
`isPending`: no data yet. `isFetching`: a request is running, including background refetches.
